title: Top k frequent elements
statement: Return the k most frequent values, most frequent first; break ties by smaller value first.
hints: Count with a hash map first.
Then select the top k of the (count, value) pairs: heap, sort, or bucket by count.
complexity: O(n + u log k) with a heap; O(n) with buckets

solution.explanation: Two separate steps: count (hash map, O(n)), then select. Selecting with a size-k heap is O(u log k) for u distinct values; bucket sort by frequency (counts are at most n) is O(n). The tie rule here makes the answer unique: say out loud how you'd handle ties before you code.
solution.python:
import heapq

from collections import Counter
import heapq

def top_k_frequent(nums, k):
    cnt = Counter(nums)
    return [x for _, x in heapq.nsmallest(k, ((-c, x) for x, c in cnt.items()))]
